scenario: Arithmetic in `where` clauses under logical per LLOG.5.1 — standard expression evaluation applies inside logical LHS conditions. Pin: rule emits logical fact only when `s.temp - s.baseline > 5`; retracts when that condition becomes false.
rules_ds:
schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    temp: Float mutable
    baseline: Float mutable

schema Alarm scope logical:
    dummy: Int key

rule spike:
    Sensor s where (s.temp - s.baseline) > 5.0
->
    emit Alarm logical dummy: 0
